title: 六大网络**加码：PMI要冲扩张线，K型分化还在
speaker: Carlos Casanova

segments.en: Carlos Casanova in the meantime senior Asia economist at UBP so we're finally seeing some expansion again in the manufacturing side
segments.zh: 与此同时，瑞联银行高级亚洲经济学家卡洛斯·卡萨诺瓦。我们终于看到制造业再次出现一些扩张。

segments.en: are we starting to see signs of this kind of fiscal support coming through in the numbers
segments.zh: 我们是否开始从数据中看到这类财政支持的迹象？

segments.en: correct I think so and I'm glad I mean we brought that up because the measure is predominantly to promote these investments in the six networks
segments.zh: 没错，我认为是这样。很高兴我们提到这一点，因为这项措施主要是为了推动六大网络领域的相关投入。

segments.en: so it's an acceleration of fiscal stimulus and we are seeing this theme of fiscal dominance playing out in China as well in the second half of this year
segments.zh: 所以这是财政刺激的加速，我们也看到今年下半年中国财政主导的主题正在展开。

segments.en: and it's already leading to some pickup in manufacturing activity we expect that it's going to remain k-shaped
segments.zh: 这已经带动制造业活动有所回升，我们预计经济仍将保持K型分化。

segments.en: so we're going to see that rating dog PMI probably much higher in expansionary territory
segments.zh: 所以我们会看到RatingDog PMI可能更高，处于扩张区间。

segments.en: but there are some signs or some green shoots that some of this fiscal support is going to at least bring us to what's the I would say in middle of that target for 2026 not the lower end
segments.zh: 但有一些迹象或绿芽显示，部分财政支持至少会把我们带到2026年目标区间的中段，而不是下限。

segments.en: I think maybe a little bit above 4.5 percent
Okay so how does the fourth quarter look in as far as the bottom part of the k is concerned so like do we get a meaningful improvement in those parts of the economy?
segments.zh: 那么，就K型的下半部分而言，第四季度表现如何？这些经济领域会有实质性改善吗？
